page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9a.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T25 processor clocked at 2.7 GHz, providing 8 dedicated vCPUs paired with 32.0 GB of system memory. This architecture establishes a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, maintaining balanced resource density for general computing environments.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system images and persistent data. In terms of connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network throughput of 6 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring elastic IP configuration for public routing.

With dedicated vCPU provisioning and no GPU acceleration, ecs.g9a.2xlarge avoids hypervisor-level CPU contention. Its balanced hardware configuration aligns with mid-tier enterprise application hosting, microservices clusters, continuous integration workers, web application servers, and standard relational database engines.
